messages:
mira: quick idea — prototyping a lightweight 'preflight' ingest harness for models. goal: fast compatibility + tiny perf smoke so runtime doesn't get surprises. run in registry CI or as a separate service?

alex: +1. UX question: sync on upload vs async webhook. sync gives immediate feedback but can block users.

mira: leaning hybrid. do a strict lightweight sync check (timeout 30s) that covers shape/dtype/tokenizer/mini-generate. heavy checks async (full perf, quant profiles).

phil: flag on cost. at scale we can't full-run heavy checks for every upload. propose default smoke for all, deep checks only for new model families or flagged uploads.

sam: interface point: registry should emit a single 'preflight-report' JSON blob and status. runtime only consumes that blob; avoids coupling.

mira: agreed. minimal report sketch:
```json
{
  "artifact_hash":"sha256:...",
  "checks":[{"name":"onnx_load","status":"pass"},{"name":"kv_cache_shape","status":"warn","details":"last_dim_mismatch"}],
  "preferred_kernel":"fused_attention_v2","kernel_confidence":0.87
}
```

alex: kernel hint is important. runtime can prefer that but still fallback. include model size and tokenization checksum too.

phil: ops question — where do we run these runners? small k8s pool in ml infra or reuse validator runners in eng-infra? cost and isolation tradeoffs.

infra-bot: deploy job queued: validators/preflight-runner:v0.3 -> pool=ml-preflight-small (spot). est-runtime 10m.

mira: for policy: (1) add a manifest field for quantization profiles, (2) define compatibility error codes (CRITICAL / WARN / INFO), (3) expose a one-click revalidate endpoint in console.

sam: i'll draft the schema doc with error codes and webhook payload today.

alex: also consider a KV-cache warming probe: do a short forward-pass to prime caches and measure tail latency for a single request shape. keep it optional.

phil: cost-policy owners: we should cap warm/probe runs per org per day and add sample-rate config. i'll make a proposal.

mira: owners: sam=schema+report shape, phil=cost policy, alex=runtime-hinting, mira=preflight-runner infra.

mira: followups: PR for schema, small demo job to show a failed kv-cache shape warning, and docs section for "ingest preflight".

sam: PR incoming in ~3h.

mira: thanks — this feels like a good middle ground between immediate feedback and cost control. will sync w/ security about artifact signing next. :thumbsup:
